# Pinned interlanguage adoption fixture

This directory contains only the four-file machine-ingestion contract from exact upstream closure commit `06f918eee33729f760b1459934f9a50c2aca9e31` of [`KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts`](https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts). Source commit `10d2df083bf0b47b758d5f094b6fcaeed9167011` introduced the bounded scope split; commit `62b13062c7b3deea30fd924d6cf585fd637a58f8` is the first commit containing the complete clean four-file contract; and `06f918e…` closes its public evidence. This fixture supersedes `5ccd935…` before Commons integration so native CI validates the one production snapshot that the public adapter actually supports rather than generated lookalikes.

The exact byte lengths and SHA-256 identities are code-reviewed in `tools/interlanguage_adoption_pin.json`. The 156,274-byte fixture contains coordination metadata, a JSON Schema, a clean validation receipt, and a map-identity manifest. It exposes 66 bounded rows: eight maintained current rows, 53 unclaimed adoption-ready rows, and five future rows. The former aggregate IDs `noether-multilingual` and `grothendieck-school` are not claimable items; 16 Noether language/work rows and six Grothendieck-school work rows replace them. The validation receipt records `named_worktree_files`, exact base `10d2df0…`, and `worktree_dirty: false`. Queue-source hashes, workflow declarations, human-board/index projections, ownership semantics, consumer/claim regressions, board/issue audit modes, and continuous validation remain metadata, not mathematical or source authority. The fixture includes no queue document, manuscript, scan, translation, or producer artifact.

The upstream repository dedicates its project-created metadata and manifests under CC0 1.0. Linked manuscripts, editions, scans, translations, and other third-party works retain their own rights; neither this fixture nor a passing test imports or relicenses them.
